f3_program: partition("oil.cans", at("oil.total_volume", "current"), source("290 liters of oil in 24 cans"))

product_relation(at("oil.cans.eight_liter_group.total_volume", "current"), at("oil.cans.eight_liter_group.count", "current"), at("oil.cans.eight_liter_group.volume_per_can", "current"), source("10 of the cans are holding 8 liters each"))
assumptions: The collection's physical location is not stated; "unspecified" preserves that omission.

f3_program: collection("parking_lot.sections", "section", "parking_lot", source("parking lot is divided into 3 sections"))
partition("parking_lot.sections", at("parking_lot.spaces.count", "current"), source("parking lot is divided into 3 sections"))
offset(at("parking_lot.section_2.spaces.count", "current"), at("parking_lot.section_3.spaces.count", "current"), 200, "count", source("200 more in section 2 than in section 3"))

offset(at("area.certain_house.construction_cost", "current"), at("area.other_houses.construction_cost_per_house", "current"), 100000, "currency", source("The cost of building a certain house in an area is 100,000 more than the construction cost of each of the houses in the area"))
multiple(at("area.certain_house.sale_price", "current"), at("area.other_houses.sale_price_per_house", "current"), 1.5, source("it sells for 1.5 times as much as the other houses"))
assumptions: The houses used as the construction-cost comparison are the other houses referenced in the following sentence, and "it" refers to the certain house.
Answering requires converting one year into months, a time-unit conversion not asserted by the source or provided by the F3-v1 allowlist.

f3_program: observe(at("company.rsus_prsus.granted_shares", "between December 30, 2018 and December 29, 2019"), 353, "thousand_shares", cell("Granted", "Number of Shares"))
query("mean", at("company.rsus_prsus.nonvested_shares", "January 1, 2017"), at("company.rsus_prsus.granted_shares", "between December 30, 2018 and December 29, 2019"))
assumptions: The date interval selects the Granted row containing 353 thousand shares between the two dated nonvested-balance rows.
